content.short: Cryptobus.FM is a Cardano-linked crypto podcast project focused on personal stories and blockchain culture.
content.description: Cryptobus.FM is a crypto podcast and media project built around conversations from a bright red Cryptobus. Instead of treating blockchain only as trading, marketing, or price speculation, the project focuses on personal stories, human experiences, and cultural touchpoints across the crypto world. Its Cardano connection sits in community education and media, helping listeners understand blockchain through people and narratives. Cryptobus.FM brings a more accessible, interview-driven format to crypto learning.
